decisions.reason: Report explicitly identifies PID 42432 (dsh web host) from running-processes.txt as the koffi.node loader, explains the OS keeps the loaded native binary open until process exit so npm's copyfile gets EBUSY (matching attempt1-ebusy.log).

Explains refreshing only reloads the SPA while the host process stays alive, and gives an ordered numbered procedure: fully exit the dsh host (verify with tasklist), run install, then restart. Does not prescribe killing unrelated node processes.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: unpinned install follows latest which is 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, so the unpinned command replaces alpha.4 with rc.2 — downgrade explained, not endorsed.

Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, and restarts; @alpha mentioned only as a discussed tag, exact version is the primary command.

Section 4 advises README authors to never publish unpinned combined commands, to pin an exact known-compatible dsh version (or omit dsh from the command), and to avoid silently following latest — the unpinned command is quoted as a BAD example.
